description: Climate Toolbox is a decision-support tool listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Climate Impacts Research Consortium; USDA Northwest Climate Hub; University of Idaho | Northwest Knowledge Network. Access a range of tools that offer climate and hydrologic data for the contiguous United States. The sites' popular tools include: The Climate Mapper Tool – summary maps of gridded climate and hydrology from past observations to future projections. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Cold, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Water Infrastructure – General. The listed link gives the project or repository page; nothing was installed or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
